after.zh: SIFT 描述子把关键点周围分成 4×4 个小格，每格做一个 8 个方向的直方图，一共 128 个数。方向按梯度分，幅值当票数：边往哪个方向变亮，这一格就往那个方向投票。
after.en: A SIFT descriptor divides the area round a keypoint into 4×4 small cells and makes an 8-direction histogram in each, 128 numbers in all. Directions follow the gradient and the magnitude is the vote: whichever way an edge brightens, the cell votes that way.

t.zh: 一个点光知道「在哪」还不够，还要记下它周围长什么样，才认得出。SIFT 的办法是数一数周围的边都朝哪个方向。
t.en: Knowing where a point is is not enough to recognise it; you also need to record what its surroundings look like. SIFT does it by counting which way the edges around it face.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：把每一格的梯度幅值分到上下左右四个方向，输出四个方向各自的平均。
t.en: Your task in this level: share each cell's gradient magnitude out to the four directions up, down, left and right, and output the average for each.

brief.zh: 把每一格的梯度幅值分给它最接近的方向：横向分量更大时，往右变亮算「→」，往左算「←」；纵向分量更大时，往下变亮算「↓」，往上算「↑」。四个输出是四个方向各自的幅值总和除以格数。
brief.en: Give each cell's gradient magnitude to the direction it is closest to: when the across part is larger, brightening to the right counts as "→" and to the left as "←"; when the down part is larger, brightening downwards counts as "↓" and upwards as "↑". The four outputs are the magnitude summed per direction, divided by the number of cells.

hint.zh: |gx| 是 gx 和 −gx 里较大的那个。每个方向是两个条件同时成立：哪个分量大，它的正负号。
hint.en: |gx| is the larger of gx and −gx. Each direction needs two conditions at once: which part is larger, and its sign.
